messages.author: 5117fd6c9c423ce1
messages.subject: slider .. on a plot?  Possible?
parts: I was wondering if something were any way possible in my Shiny app.  If you look at the attached screen capture - where there is a red line going across my plot, and the line corresponds to the input 'threshold' value?  I was thinking, would it not be cool if one could grab the red line in the plot, and actively move it up and down.   There isn't any clever way in existing Shiny widgets to do that, right?  I don't think so, but I thought I'd ask :)  thanks.

messages.author: 4be88a5fc86a040f
messages.subject: Re: slider .. on a plot?  Possible?
parts:
There are plenty of javascript libraries for interactive plots. I don't recall any of them having the exact feature you need.

Extending the libraries would require some javascript programming. But you may want to check out Highcharts boxplot demo (free for non-commercial use) and rCharts package (wrapper for several javascript libraries).
